name: v1-deepseek
hypothesis: Extraction only, same model as v0: most F2 misses on the baseline were city/state/website the reference re-asserted and v0 left out because they matched the record; asking for confirmed values, taking the website from an anchored company page, and keeping only same-domain regex emails (the wrong novel findings were directory/newspaper emails) should raise F2 and F3 precision at token cost only.
